title: E-commerce Operations Analyst
summary: Analyse order, inventory and fulfilment data for an online retailer to find bottlenecks, track KPIs and support weekly trading decisions across our own web store and third-party marketplaces.
responsibilities: Build and maintain weekly KPI dashboards for orders, returns, stock-outs and delivery times
Write SQL queries to investigate fulfilment delays and inventory gaps
Reconcile sales and stock data across the web store and marketplace channels
Present findings and recommendations to category and operations managers
must_have_skills: E-commerce platform experience (Shopify or marketplace seller tools)
education_preference: Bachelor's degree in business, statistics, engineering or a related field
